title: HAVING Clause in SQL
definition: HAVING is used to filter grouped data after applying GROUP BY. It is mainly used with aggregate functions.

basic_having.heading: Basic HAVING Example
basic_having.query: SELECT customer, SUM(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY customer HAVING SUM(amount) > 500;

having_with_count.heading: HAVING with COUNT
having_with_count.query: SELECT customer, COUNT(order_id) FROM orders GROUP BY customer HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 1;

having_with_avg.heading: HAVING with AVG
having_with_avg.query: SELECT customer, AVG(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY customer HAVING AVG(amount) > 250;

common_mistake.heading: Common Mistake
common_mistake.wrong_query: SELECT customer, SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE SUM(amount) > 500 GROUP BY customer;
common_mistake.correct_query: SELECT customer, SUM(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY customer HAVING SUM(amount) > 500;
